title: Are LLM-Judges Robust to Expressions of Uncertainty? Investigating the effect of Epistemic Markers on LLM-based Evaluation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-judges on Question Answering (single evaluation) and Instruction Following (pairwise evaluation) tasks using the EMBER benchmark, which systematically augments model outputs with epistemic markers (strengtheners and weakeners) to measure changes in the LLM-judge's accuracy and Verdict Switch Rate.
